title: Best Custom Greeting Card and Video Makers (2026): Personal Gifts
description: How to hire someone for custom greeting cards or personal greeting videos for birthdays, holidays or businesses: formats, timing and red flags.
intro: Greeting card and video makers create personalized cards and short videos for birthdays, holidays, weddings, thank-yous and business greetings. A thoughtful custom card or video feels more personal than anything off the shelf. Orders go wrong when names are misspelled, delivery is too late for the date, or music and images are used without permission. This guide helps you order greetings that arrive on time and feel special.

faq.a: Digital cards and videos arrive instantly. Printed cards need printing and shipping time.

faq.q: Can the video include my photos?
faq.a: Yes. Send clear photos and short clips, and check you have permission to use them.

faq.q: Can a character or presenter say the greeting?
faq.a: Some creators perform greetings or use animated characters. Avoid characters you do not have rights to.

faq.q: Can businesses send greetings to clients?
faq.a: Yes. Many makers create branded holiday cards and videos.
Digital greetings can be quick; printed cards need extra time. Order early for holidays.
